title: Minimum Moves to Convert String
summary: Given a string s with characters 'X' or 'O', a move consists of changing any three consecutive 'X's to 'O's.
statement: Given a string s with characters 'X' or 'O', a move consists of changing any three consecutive 'X's to 'O's. Calculate the least number of moves needed to convert all characters to 'O'.
constraints: s has 3 through 1000 characters, each X or O.
One move selects any three consecutive positions and changes all of them to O.
Return the fewest moves needed to leave no X.
hints: The leftmost remaining X must be covered by some move, and starting that move as far left as possible covers the most future positions.
Scan left to right; on X count a move and skip its three covered positions, otherwise advance one.
If s[i]==X: moves++, i+=3; else i+=1.
Any solution must spend a move covering the current leftmost X; shifting that move to start at i cannot lose coverage of an earlier unresolved position and maximizes rightward coverage.
editorial: Any solution must spend a move covering the current leftmost X; shifting that move to start at i cannot lose coverage of an earlier unresolved position and maximizes rightward coverage.

tests.explanation: One move covers all three X characters.
A move starting at zero covers the first two X characters, and a second move covers the final X.
